answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 56494 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Question regarding Insurance. Question: I have a small query regarding insurance, I live in Saudi Arabia and it is a part of a law here to have a car insurance, in the case of an accident they might jail you for not having it, what would you say in this regard? Answer ID: 56494 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 58/48/N=01/1436) It is allowable to have car insurance in case of legal compulsion. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
